description: Ferryhopper helps travelers plan ferry journeys across Europe and the Mediterranean. Users can look up ferry ports, see which destinations are reachable directly from a port, search one-way, round-trip or island-hopping sailings of up to five legs with indicative prices and per-segment availability (cabins, vehicles, pets, e-tickets), inspect a specific sailing's vessel amenities, photos and accommodation options, and check disruption alerts such as strikes, weather warnings and cancellations. Search results link to ferryhopper.com, where the user completes the booking.
